sentences.en: (British English) And that's one of the things that I enjoy most about this convention.
sentences.zh: (英国英语) 这是我最喜欢这个会议的东西之一。

sentences.en: It's not so much, as so little has to do with what everything is.
sentences.zh: 这并不重要,因为没有什么 做的一切是什么。

sentences.en: (Laughter) But it is within our self-interest to understand the topography of our lives unto ourselves.
sentences.zh: 但了解我们生命的地形 符合我们自身的利益

sentences.en: (Laughter) The future states that there is no time other than the collapsation of that sensation of the mirror of the memories in which we are living.
sentences.zh: (笑声) 未来 说,没有时间了, 仅仅 折叠的这种感觉 镜子 我们生活的记忆。

sentences.en: (Laughter) Common knowledge, but important nonetheless.
sentences.zh: 常识,但很重要

sentences.en: (Laughter) As we face fear in these times, and fear is all around us, we also have anti-fear.
sentences.zh: 当我们在这个时代面临恐惧 恐惧在我们身边 我们也有反恐惧

sentences.en: It's hard to imagine or measure. The background radiation is simply too static to be able to be seen under the normal spectral analysis.
sentences.zh: 很难想象或测量。背景辐射太静态,无法在正常的光谱分析下看到。

sentences.en: (American accent) But we feel as though there are times when a lot of us -- you know what I'm saying?
sentences.zh: (美国口音) 但我们觉得有的时候,我们很多人 -- 你知道我在说什么吗?

sentences.en: But -- you know what I'm saying? Because, as a hip hop thing, you know what I'm saying, TED be rocking -- you know what I'm saying.
sentences.zh: 但是,你知道我在说什么吗?因为,作为一个跳跃的事情,你知道我的意思,TED正在摇摆——你知道我在说什么。

sentences.en: Like so I wrote a song, and I hope you guys dig it.
sentences.zh: 就像我写了一首歌, 我希望你们喜欢它。

sentences.en: It's a song about people and sasquatches -- (Laughter) And other French science stuff.
sentences.zh: 这是一首关于人和鱼群的歌 -- (笑声) 还有法国的其他科学作品。

sentences.en: That's French science. Okay, here we go.
sentences.zh: 这是法国科学,好了,开始吧

sentences.en: (Applause) that I'm in trouble by myself But every time it gets me
sentences.zh: (掌声) 我自己有麻烦 但每次它得到我

sentences.zh: (唱歌) 我一直想成为你相信的人 而你是我想变得如此温柔的人

sentences.en: And you can do anything as long as you don't get hurt along the way back (Beatbox) If I survive, I'm going to tell you what is wrong Because if you were [unclear]
sentences.zh: 只要你在回来的路上不受伤 我就能告诉你什么是错的 因为如果你是错的

sentences.en: And I think that you're looking like a [unclear] I give you what I want to be (Music)
sentences.zh: 我认为你看起来像一个[不清楚] 我给了你我想要的

sentences.en: (Music ends abruptly) (British accent) And it's like, you could use as many of those things that you want.
sentences.zh: (音乐突然结束) (英国口音) 它就像,你可以使用 尽可能多的那些你想要的东西。

sentences.en: (Applause) And the computer models, no matter how many that you have and how many people that you use, are never going to be able to arrive at the same conclusions.
sentences.zh: (掌声) 计算机模型,无论你有多少人, 以及你使用多少人, 都不可能得出相同的结论。

sentences.en: Four years ago I worked with a few people at the Brookings Institute, and I arrived at a conclusion.
sentences.zh: 四年前,我在布鲁金斯学院与一些人合作,我得出了一个结论。

sentences.en: (Laughter) Tomorrow is another day. (Laughter) Not just any day,
sentences.zh: (笑) 明天是又一天。 (笑)不只是一天,

sentences.en: but it is a day. It will get here, there's no question.
sentences.zh: 但它是一个日子。它会到达这里,没有问题。

sentences.en: And the important thing to remember is that this simulation is a good one.
sentences.zh: 重要的是,这个模拟是一个好的模拟。

sentences.en: It's believable, it's tactile. You can reach out -- things are solid.
sentences.zh: 这是可以相信的,是触觉的。你可以伸手——事情是可靠的。

sentences.en: You can move objects from one area to another.
sentences.zh: 您可以将对象从一个区域移动到另一个区域。

sentences.en: You can feel your body. You can say, "I'd like to go over to this location," and you can move this mass of molecules through the air over to another location, at will.
sentences.zh: 你可以感觉到你的身体。你可以说,“我想去这个地方,” 你可以通过空气将分子的质量 转移到另一个地方,随意。

sentences.en: (Laughter) That's something you live inside of every day.
sentences.zh: 这是你每天生活在里面的东西。

sentences.en: Now with the allocation and the understanding of the lack of understanding, we enter into a new era of science in which we feel nothing more than so much so as to say that those within themselves,
sentences.zh: 现在,随着分配和对缺乏理解的理解,我们进入了一个新的科学时代,在这个时代中,我们感到没有什么比说他们自己,

sentences.en: comporary or non-comporary, will figuratively figure into the folding of our non-understanding and our partial understanding to the networks of which we all draw our source
sentences.zh: 比较或非计算, 将比喻成 折叠我们的不理解 和我们部分理解 网络,我们都抽出我们的源头

sentences.en: and conclusions from. (Laughter) So, as I say before the last piece, feel not as though it is a sphere we live on, rather an infinite plane which has the illusion
sentences.zh: (笑声) 因此,正如我在最后一块之前所说, 感觉它不像一个球 我们生活在, 而不是一个无限的平面 具有幻觉

sentences.en: of leading yourself back to the point of origin.
sentences.zh: 让你自己回到原点

sentences.en: (Laughter) Once we understand that all the spheres in the sky are just large infinite planes, it will be plain to see.
sentences.zh: 一旦我们明白天空中的所有球体 都只是无穷无尽的天体 就会明白

sentences.en: (Laughter) (Audience) (Laughter) This is my final piece.
sentences.zh: (笑声) (观众) (笑声) 这是我最后的作品。

sentences.en: And just remember, everything you are -- it's more important to realize the negative space, as music is only the division of space; it is the space we are listening to divided as such,
sentences.zh: 记住,你的一切-- 更重要的是要认识到消极的空间, 因为音乐只是空间的划分; 它是我们所听到的分裂的空间,

sentences.en: which gives us the information in comparison to something other that gives us the idea of what the idea that wants to be transmitted wants to be.
sentences.zh: 给我们的信息 与其它的东西相比 给了我们一个想法 想要被传递的想法是什么

sentences.en: So please, without further ado. (Applause) Thank you.
sentences.zh: 所以请不要再多说了 谢谢
